input: Directional revamp foundation: business.mjs, products-first hero, /products/, /industries/, nav, sitemap, tests

doc_friction.issue: The dead-link walk and two build.test.mjs link tests did not know that grants/ is served by the site Worker (cloudflare/router.mjs APP_DIRS), so the first page to link the live product failed both. Both now skip APP_DIRS prefixes.

deviations.why: Two new nav items would overflow the one-row header budget, so the 'Deploy your own' label became 'Self-host'. The footer keeps 'Deploy your own copy'.
deviations.result: site-nav width test passes with 10 items

notes: business.mjs is the single product-line source (siblings import it); products.mjs writes /products/, /industries/ and a default industries/<slug>/ page each (construction, manufacturing, online-sellers, eu-e-invoicing, nonprofits) that a later sibling page replaces. Verification: platform/pages node --test *.test.mjs: 1958 pass, and the 3 failures (Worker-served grants/ links, sitemap list) were fixed then rerun; full build + check.mjs: 'looks publishable: 1437 products, 54 category pages, 13152 pages, no dead links'; --only preview screenshots at 1280 and 390 px, light and dark, no sideways scroll. Only Grant Autopilot marked live (test-enforced). After merging main (siblings had landed industry-nonprofits.mjs, hardware-page.mjs and check.mjs isWorkerServed): conflicts resolved by keeping theirs and adding products/industries; the duplicate Worker exemption was dropped in favour of main's isWorkerServed; the sitemap dedupes industries/nonprofits/; the nonprofits page still overwrites the default one (written later). Rerun: 113 pass on the affected suites; build.test+check.test 433 pass, 2 fail; full build + check.mjs 1 problem. All three come from main, not this diff: machine-shop-guides (PR #18708, merged minutes earlier) has no launch date and grew the catch-all category to 6, and a category count-line wording change ('22 tools · free, no account' vs the test's '22 free tools · no account').
